en: Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a busy central square with many horse-drawn carriages and pedestrians. On the left dominates a large Gothic church with buttresses and a high roof; in front and to the right are multi-story townhouses with shops at street level bearing German-language signs. The reverse side has a divided back with printed trilingual heading "Brașov—Kronstadt—Brassó" and the publisher credit "Verlag H. Zeidner."
